provenance: Expanded deterministically from the declared axes. Every expected_n is null because no parent experiment ever ran this entry: SPDR-018 measured the parents' own exit geometries on different entry objects, and no emission anywhere in the programme carries a signal, fill or episode count for the SoT §6.1 breakout at any (clock, delta). A number here would be invented, so the stratum is declared UNKNOWN and the realised n, CI and MDE carry every inference. The c basis (resolution_basis.json) is pinned so the realised n converts to a resolution the moment it is measured.
gating: NONE. Expected resolution never admits, excludes, labels or ranks a cell.
